chalisa.do1: Śrī Śanīścara Devajī, hear my cry with your ears. Lord, destroyer of countless obstacles, do not delay in doing me good.
chalisa.so1: Lord, I sing your praise with both hands joined. Remover of obstacles, son of Ravi, take me under your protection.
chalisa.cau1: Śanideva, I remember you; give me learning, wisdom and knowledge. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: I recount your many names, whatever I, of small understanding, know. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: I propitiate you as Antaka, Koṇa and Raudra; I proclaim to all the names Kṛṣṇa, Babhru and Śani. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: You are Piṅgala, Manda and Sauri, giver of happiness, knower of the good and ill of the whole world. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Whoever chants your name daily, you free him from disease and sorrow. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Under an adverse sign, demons, gods and men, serpents with Śeṣa, and the Vidyādharas, ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: kings and paupers who are faring well, beasts, birds and forest creatures: of all of them ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: the forests, forts, camps and armies, every village and whole cities: you bring them all to ruin. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: You cast obstacles into everyone's happiness; all grow distressed and fall into sorrow. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Lord, this is my prayer to you: show me abundant mercy. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Lord, for my good, do not dwell in an adverse sign; this is my only hope. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Those who on Saturday give jaggery, black gram, sesame, barley, iron, grain, wealth and clothes ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: become happy by giving these gifts. You are that Śani: hear this prayer of ours. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Lord, show mercy to me, that millions of obstacles may perish in a moment. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Lord, I bow to you with both hands joined; be merciful and hear my prayer. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Sometimes at Prayāga, king of holy places, sometimes lovingly on the bank of the Sarayū, ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: sometimes in the pure stream of the Sarasvatī, or somewhere in mountain hollows and caves, ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: the yogis who meditate: in their meditation Śani becomes subtle. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: He is beyond reach; what praise can I give him? I bow, my head at his feet. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Whoever turns back from abroad on a Saturday and comes to his own home ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: stays happy, by Śanideva's name I swear it; the son of Ravi keeps him well protected. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Those who go abroad on a Saturday do not come home, and suffer distress. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Śani brings hardship on such a one, and he is as sorrowful at heart as one can be. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: To that same son of Ravi I, foolish and of little understanding, bow with joined hands. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Brahmā is the maker of the world; Viṣṇu daily gives food to all. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: There is Śiva, bearer of the trident, foe of Tripura. These all-pervading gods are one form. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: As one, they ever hold Śani in mind; they bow to Śani with minds subdued. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: The man who reads this with heart and mind is freed from boundless suffering. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Good sons are born to him, his wealth and offspring grow; Kali and Kāla stand before him with joined hands. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: His home stays ever filled with all things: cattle, family, kin and the rest. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: He enjoys pleasures of many kinds and every happiness, and at the end, leaving the world, ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: attains liberation, the immortal state, brother, he who daily meditates on Śani with an even mind. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Whoever recites the ten names of Śani in the morning, Śanīścara ever stays under his sway. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Affliction from Śani never comes to whoever rises daily and meditates on him. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Those who recite this Chālīsā gain happiness; the Lord of the world is witness. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Whoever reads it every morning for forty days, Śani destroys his many sins. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Such is the majesty of the son of Ravi, brother, that he destroys the darkness of delusion in the world. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Whoever recites this will never lack happiness and wealth. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Whoever meditates on him in his mind night and day, troubles of mind and body come nowhere near him. ॥39॥
chalisa.do2: Vimala has prepared this reading of Śanīścara Deva. Reading it for forty days, one crosses the ocean of worldly existence.
chalisa.do3: The hymn that Daśaratha sang, beholding Śani before him, that same hymn Lalitā has refined and written in sweet, fine language.
